# Allshore Engineering, LLC

> Structural engineering firm based in Haleiwa, Oahu, Hawaii. Established 2011.
> Structural design, calculations, construction documents, assessments and
> inspections for residential, commercial, marine and waterfront,
> infrastructure and specialty structures.

## What we do
- Residential: custom homes, additions, renovations, ADUs, garages, lanais, retaining walls, coastal and flood-zone homes
- Commercial and institutional: new buildings, pre-engineered metal buildings, churches, schools, hotel and resort projects, renovations, equipment anchorage
- Specialty structures: machine and equipment foundations, lifting frames and spreader bars, load-test frames, crane supports, shade structures and canopies, solar racking, towers and poles, temporary works and shoring
- Marine and waterfront: marinas and small boat harbors, aluminum floating docks and gangways, piers and wharves, seawalls, bollards and fendering, moorings
- Infrastructure: bridge evaluation and load rating, culverts, retaining walls, utility structures
- Assessments and inspections: condition assessments, pre-purchase structural evaluations, damage evaluations, special inspection and structural observation

## Where we work
Oahu, Maui, Kauai, Hawaii Island, Molokai and Lanai. Projects also completed on the U.S. mainland and overseas.
